bias.en: Bearish · capped at the September lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 受制于 9月低点

read.en: Broadcom rose 1.8% on Oct 19 to $334.59, ending a three-day decline, trading between $333.82 and $340.20. It is below its 5-day ($342.3), 10-day ($354.0), 30-day ($354.2), 100-day ($379.5) and 200-day ($368.1) averages, all falling. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 15 and is below zero with a widening gap, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($372.3), and RSI is 38.7.
read.zh: 博通 10月19日上涨 1.8%，收于 $334.59，结束连续三日下跌，盘中区间 $333.82–340.20。股价位于全部下行的 5 日（$342.3）、10 日（$354.0）、30 日（$354.2）、100 日（$379.5）和 200 日均线（$368.1）下方。MACD 于 10月15日下穿信号线，位于零轴下方且差距扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$372.3），RSI 为 38.7。

read.en: The rebound stalled at $340 and closed just under the $334.6–335.8 resistance (Sep 16 and Oct 15 lows), while the $328.6 Oct 16 low held. Resistance is $335–340, then $342–344 (5-day average, Oct 1 low) and $354 (10 and 30-day). Support is $328.6, then $321–324 (Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows) and $314–316. A close below $321 would open $315.

r.en: Sep 16 and Oct 15 lows ($334.6–335.8); Oct 19 high $340.2
